versions.changelog:
Initial release of the 视频案例分析助手 (video-analysis-workflow):

- Enables one-click analysis for local and online (抖音/B站) videos, automatically breaking them down into structured video cases.
- Extracts and outputs four standardized reports: case analysis, storyboard frames, script template, and transcript, ready for use in Obsidian case libraries.
- Features automated extraction of key elements: scene breakdown, visual rhythm, narration, structural analysis, and reusable script prompts.
- Supports both local video files and platform links (with download handling guidance); integrates with existing download skills and yt-dlp for B站.
- Outputs organized folder structures with Markdown and optional HTML reports for easy team reuse and sharing.
- Equipped with robust handling for Chinese file paths, platform-specific quirks, and fallback logic for video downloads and transcription edge cases.
